beats.text: Everybody wants control. But control costs.
beats.spoken: Everybody wants control. But control costs.

beats.text: Core provides two-sided liquidity. Other reserves have different jobs.
beats.spoken: Core provides two-sided liquidity. Other reserves have different jobs.

beats.text: Sell through active downside ranges: Ether becomes OMR.
beats.spoken: Sell through active downside ranges: Ether becomes O M R.

beats.text: Buy through upside ranges: OMR becomes Ether.
beats.spoken: Buy through upside ranges: O M R becomes Ether.

beats.text: Crossing isn't final. Until withdrawal, inventory can still convert back.
beats.spoken: Crossing isn't final. Until withdrawal, inventory can still convert back.

beats.text: Finalization removes eligible positions, separating principal from fees.
beats.spoken: Finalization removes eligible positions, separating principal from fees.

beats.text: Deployment spends capacity. Deposits and withdrawals don't reset it.
beats.spoken: Deployment spends capacity. Deposits and withdrawals don't reset it.

beats.text: Completed pool history informs each move, checked against current conditions.
beats.spoken: Completed pool history informs each move, checked against current conditions.

beats.text: Stress gates, cooldowns and capacity limit deployment.
beats.spoken: Stress gates, cooldowns and capacity limit deployment.

beats.text: Surge fees, bond proceeds and arbitrage shares fund the War Chest.
beats.spoken: Surge fees, bond proceeds and arbitrage shares fund the War Chest.

beats.text: Refill requires a full window of spaced, healthy observations.
beats.spoken: Refill requires a full window of spaced, healthy observations.

beats.text: Only actual idle assets move. Lifetime limits stay spent.
beats.spoken: Only actual idle assets move. Lifetime limits stay spent.

beats.text: A bounce creates no Ether. No guaranteed floor.
beats.spoken: A bounce creates no Ether. No guaranteed floor.

beats.text: Canonical sells pay nine percent, split four ways.
beats.spoken: Canonical sells pay nine percent, split four ways.

beats.text: Three percent funds Core. Up to one extra percent funds stability.
beats.spoken: Three percent funds Core. Up to one extra percent funds stability.

beats.text: Fees settle in Ether or OMR, including partial fills.
beats.spoken: Fees settle in Ether or O M R, including partial fills.

beats.text: Opening buys have temporary fees and limits. Afterwards, no Hook buy tax.
beats.spoken: Opening buys have temporary fees and limits. Afterwards, no Hook buy tax.

beats.text: Other venues have their own rules. Pool liquidity fees are separate.
beats.spoken: Other venues have their own rules. Pool liquidity fees are separate.

beats.text: Pay Ether for bonds backed by existing OMR, released through linear vesting.
beats.spoken: Pay Ether for bonds backed by existing O M R, released through linear vesting.

beats.text: No minting. No sellback. Purchasing pauses don't erase vested claims.
beats.spoken: No minting. No sellback. Purchasing pauses don't erase vested claims.

beats.text: Solvers commit a plan, then fund a two-pool arbitrage cycle.
beats.spoken: Solvers commit a plan, then fund a two-pool arbitrage cycle.

beats.text: Profit is checked after costs and reserve share. Failed gas remains your risk.
beats.spoken: Profit is checked after costs and reserve share. Failed gas remains your risk.

beats.text: Lock canonical position NFTs. Rewards require fresh, qualifying depth samples.
beats.spoken: Lock canonical position N F Tees. Rewards require fresh, qualifying depth samples.

beats.text: Rewards need funded campaigns. Mature positions can exit independently.
beats.spoken: Rewards need funded campaigns. Mature positions can exit independently.

beats.text: Families fight for seasonal Turf fees. The protocol keeps principal.
beats.spoken: Families fight for seasonal Turf fees. The protocol keeps principal.

beats.text: Syndicates split rights. Status doesn't multiply money.
beats.spoken: Syndicates split rights. Status doesn't multiply money.

beats.text: A checkpoint assigns earned fees before control changes. Existing claims keep their recipients.
beats.spoken: A checkpoint assigns earned fees before control changes. Existing claims keep their recipients.

beats.text: Sieges freeze wallets and allocate only funded escrow.
beats.spoken: Sieges freeze wallets and allocate only funded escrow.

beats.text: At season exit, fees settle; principal returns for retirement.
beats.spoken: At season exit, fees settle; principal returns for retirement.

beats.text: The Safe binds and funds systems. Keepers have budgets. The game can't withdraw principal.
beats.spoken: The Safe binds and funds systems. Keepers have budgets. The game can't withdraw principal.

beats.text: Game cash, OMR, Ether and RWA stay separate.
beats.spoken: Game cash, O M R, Ether and R W A stay separate.

beats.text: Trades change inventory. Revenue funds reserves. Conditions gate the next move.
beats.spoken: Trades change inventory. Revenue funds reserves. Conditions gate the next move.

beats.text: OMERTÀ. Control costs.
beats.spoken: Oh-MAIR-tah. Control costs.
